products.name: Commerce Media Solutions
products.description: A digital advertising platform that embeds proprietary ad-serving technology into partner e-commerce and digital media sites and mobile apps, delivering targeted, performance-based advertising at key transaction moments. Requires integration with partner infrastructure and leverages first-party data and machine learning for optimization.

products.name: Owned and Operated Digital Media Properties (O&O Sites) Customer Acquisition Services
products.description: Operation of proprietary digital media sites that attract consumers through promotional offers, collect self-declared data, and deliver targeted advertising and offers on behalf of clients. Involves digital infrastructure, direct marketing technologies, and analytics to engage users and generate qualified leads or actions.

products.name: Consumer Data Provision Services
products.description: Provision of qualified, self-declared consumer data (contact and behavioral information) to clients for their own direct marketing campaigns, collected via O&O Sites with user consent. Delivered digitally and used for multi-channel marketing outreach.

products.name: Programmatic Data Offerings
products.description: Provision of declared and modeled audience data segments for use in programmatic advertising environments, enabling privacy-compliant targeting of high-intent prospects. Delivered digitally and represents a small but strategic revenue stream.

products.name: Social Media Campaign Management Services
products.description: Managed creator marketing and media buying services for advertiser clients across social media platforms, operated through the AdParlor subsidiary. Involves digital campaign management and creative services.

products.name: Call Solutions Marketplace (Discontinued)
products.description: A live-agent, call-based performance marketing marketplace that connected consumers with advertiser clients via live call transfers and call-ready data records. Required call center operations and was focused on sectors like health insurance. Sold in January 2026.

products.name: American Eagle Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Casual, comfortable, and timeless specialty apparel and accessories for men and women, including a broad assortment of jeans, manufactured by third-party factories and sold through company-owned stores, licensed stores, and digital channels.

products.name: Aerie Intimates, Apparel, Swim, and Accessories
products.description: Intimates, apparel, swimwear, and accessories designed for comfort and inclusivity, manufactured by third-party suppliers and sold through stand-alone stores, side-by-side stores, and digital channels.

products.name: OFFLINE by Aerie Activewear and Accessories
products.description: Activewear and accessories collection focused on comfort and real movement, including leggings and sports bras, produced by third-party manufacturers and sold through dedicated stores and online.

products.name: Todd Snyder Premium Menswear
products.description: Premium menswear collections inspired by Savile Row tailoring, vintage military apparel, and classic American workwear, using elegant materials sourced globally, sold through branded stores and online.

products.name: Unsubscribed Consciously-Made Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Consciously-made, slow fashion clothing and accessories with timeless, laid-back, and luxurious designs, produced with purposefully-selected materials and sold through select stores and online.

products.name: Beauty and Wellness Products Retail
products.description: Ulta Beauty sells a broad assortment of beauty and wellness products, including cosmetics, fragrance, skincare, bath and body, haircare, and salon styling tools, from both established and emerging brands across a range of price points. These products are sold through physical stores, digital platforms, and select partnerships, requiring inventory management, physical distribution, and digital commerce infrastructure.

products.name: Salon Services
products.description: Ulta Beauty provides in-store salon services, including haircuts, styling, coloring, and other beauty treatments, delivered by licensed professionals in dedicated salon spaces within retail stores. This service requires in-person human labor and compliance with state and local regulations.

products.name: Private Label and Exclusive Beauty Products
products.description: Ulta Beauty develops and sells its own private label brand, Ulta Beauty Collection, and offers exclusive third-party brands and products, managing the full development cycle from concept through production. These products are distributed through Ulta's retail and digital channels.

products.name: Wellness Products
products.description: Ulta Beauty offers an expanded assortment of wellness products, including nutrition and supplements, intimate care, aromatherapy, spa essentials, sleep support, oral care, wearables, and wellness devices, sold through both stores and digital channels. These products are sourced from third-party brands and require compliance with relevant health and safety regulations.

products.name: E-commerce Marketplace (UB Marketplace)
products.description: Ulta Beauty operates UB Marketplace, an integrated online marketplace that allows third-party brands to sell a broader array of beauty, wellness, and lifestyle products directly to Ulta's digital customers. Ulta earns commissions on these sales, with fulfillment handled by the brands themselves, requiring digital platform management and partner integration.

products.name: Retail Media Network (UB Media)
products.description: Ulta Beauty offers media and advertising services to its brand partners through UB Media, enabling brands to reach Ulta's customer base via digital and in-store advertising channels. This service leverages Ulta's customer data and digital infrastructure to deliver targeted marketing solutions.

products.name: International Beauty Retail (Space NK and Franchise Operations)
products.description: Ulta Beauty operates international beauty retail stores through its subsidiary Space NK in the UK and Ireland, and through joint ventures and franchise agreements in Mexico and the Middle East, offering curated assortments of beauty products in physical and digital formats. These operations require local retail infrastructure and compliance with international regulations.

products.name: Term Life Insurance
products.description: Individually underwritten term life insurance policies providing a guaranteed death benefit for a fixed coverage period, sold primarily to middle-income households in the U.S. and Canada through a large network of licensed independent sales representatives. Policies are issued and administered by Primerica's insurance subsidiaries and require regulatory licensing and underwriting processes.

products.name: Mutual Funds and Retirement Plans
products.description: Distribution of a broad range of mutual funds and certain retirement plans, including employer-sponsored retirement plans (such as 401(k) and 457(b)), to individuals and small businesses. Products are sourced from third-party asset managers and delivered through licensed representatives, with recurring fee-based revenues and administrative services.

products.name: Managed Investments
products.description: Fee-based managed investment advisory programs, such as the Primerica Advisors Lifetime Investment Program, offering clients access to investment models managed by unaffiliated advisers. Requires securities licensing and is delivered digitally and through representatives, with ongoing advisory and administrative fees.

products.name: Annuities (Variable, Fixed, Indexed)
products.description: Distribution of variable, fixed, and fixed indexed annuity products issued by third-party insurance companies, providing clients with retirement income options, principal guarantees, and investment-linked returns. Products are sold through licensed representatives and require regulatory compliance.

products.name: Segregated Funds (Canada)
products.description: Canadian segregated fund products, including Primerica-branded and third-party underwritten contracts, offering investment growth with principal guarantees and insurance features. Distributed through licensed representatives and subject to Canadian insurance and securities regulation.

products.name: Mortgage Loans and Referrals
products.description: Origination and referral of residential mortgage loans, including purchase, refinance, second mortgages, and home equity lines of credit, through partnerships with third-party lenders in the U.S. and Canada. U.S. representatives are licensed mortgage originators; in Canada, services are limited to referrals.

products.name: Prepaid Legal Services
products.description: Subscription-based prepaid legal services program, providing clients access to a network of attorneys for common legal needs. The service is Primerica-branded but underwritten and administered by a third-party provider, available in the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: ID Theft Defense Services
products.description: Subscription-based identity theft defense services, offering clients protection and assistance in the event of identity theft. Provided by a third-party and distributed through Primerica's network in the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: Supplemental Health and Accidental Death & Disability Insurance (Canada)
products.description: Distribution of supplemental health, accidental death, and disability insurance products to small businesses in Canada, underwritten by third-party insurers. Delivered through licensed representatives and subject to insurance regulation.

products.name: Auto and Homeowners’ Insurance Referrals
products.description: Referral services for auto, homeowners’, and commercial insurance, connecting clients to independent agencies that provide competitive quotes from multiple insurers. Primerica receives referral fees; products are underwritten by third parties in the U.S. and Canada.

products.name: Home Automation Solutions Referrals (U.S.)
products.description: Referral service for home automation and security solutions, connecting clients to a third-party provider offering smart home products and monitoring services. Primerica receives referral fees for successful subscriptions.

products.name: IMNN-001 Immunotherapy for Ovarian Cancer
products.description: A DNA-based immunotherapeutic drug candidate for the localized treatment of advanced ovarian cancer, delivered intraperitoneally using the proprietary TheraPlas non-viral DNA delivery system, often in combination with standard chemotherapy. The product is manufactured at a cGMP clinical-scale facility and is administered via injection, requiring regulated infrastructure and clinical expertise.

products.name: PlaCCine DNA Vaccine Platform (including IMNN-101 COVID-19 Vaccine)
products.description: A synthetic, non-viral DNA vaccine technology platform designed for rapid development of vaccines against infectious diseases, including a lead candidate (IMNN-101) for COVID-19. Vaccines are produced using plasmid DNA encoding multiple antigens, delivered via a proprietary synthetic carrier, and administered by injection. The platform is adaptable for various pathogens and is supported by an established supply chain for plasmid vector production.

products.name: Weight Management Products
products.description: Meal replacement shakes, protein shakes, drink mixes, weight loss supplements, healthy snacks, and metabolism-boosting teas, manufactured in company-owned and third-party facilities and distributed globally through a direct-selling model.

products.name: Targeted Nutrition Products
products.description: Functional beverages and dietary and nutritional supplements containing herbs, vitamins, minerals, and other natural ingredients, produced using science-based formulations and distributed worldwide via direct selling.

products.name: Energy, Sports, and Fitness Products
products.description: Products supporting a healthy active lifestyle, including energy drinks and sports nutrition supplements, manufactured in company and third-party facilities and sold globally through direct selling.

products.name: Outer Nutrition Products
products.description: Facial skin care, body care, and hair care products, including specialized skincare lines, produced using advanced formulations and distributed globally through the direct-selling network.

products.name: Literature, Promotional, and Educational Materials
products.description: Start-up kits, sales tools, and educational materials provided to support Members and customers, delivered physically and digitally to facilitate product sales and business development.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Provides trade execution, custody, and clearing of securities transactions for clients through a self-clearing platform, delivered via a regulated infrastructure and technology platform.

products.name: Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Offers fee-based investment advisory platforms, including centrally managed and customized solutions, financial planning, and retirement plan consulting, delivered through digital and advisor-powered channels.

products.name: Custody and Clearing Services for Independent RIAs and Institutions
products.description: Provides technology, custody, clearing, administrative, and support services to independent registered investment advisors and institutional clients, leveraging regulated infrastructure and digital platforms.

products.name: Integrated Technology Solutions for Advisors
products.description: Delivers a cloud-based, web-accessible technology platform for advisors, including account management, document imaging, transaction execution, and portfolio rebalancing, primarily as digital solutions.

products.name: Practice Management and Business Support Services
products.description: Provides business consulting, marketing, succession planning, transition services, and operational support to advisors, delivered through a mix of digital tools and professional services.

products.name: Compliance and Risk Management Services
products.description: Offers compliance training, technology-enabled surveillance, regulatory guidance, and risk management tools to advisors and institutions, delivered via digital platforms and expert staff.

products.name: Planning and Advice Services
products.description: Provides digital and employee-powered solutions for tax planning, paraplanning, and private client support, enabling advisors to expand their advice offerings, primarily through digital and consultative channels.

products.name: In-House Investment Research
products.description: Delivers market analysis, manager research, asset allocation advice, and discretionary portfolio management to advisors, provided by an internal research team through digital and consultative means.

products.name: Insurance Brokerage Services
products.description: Offers life and disability insurance products and services as a brokerage general agency, delivered through licensed advisors and supported by digital and administrative infrastructure.

products.name: Client Cash Management Programs
products.description: Provides FDIC-insured bank sweep vehicles, client cash accounts, and money market accounts to manage client cash balances, delivered through digital account platforms and regulated banking partners.

products.name: Trust and Estate Services
products.description: Provides trust administration, investment management oversight, and IRA custodial services for estates and families, delivered through a regulated national banking association subsidiary.

products.name: Mobile Satellite Voice and Data Services
products.description: Global voice and data communications services delivered via a proprietary low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite network, accessible through handheld devices, terminals, and integrated systems for land, maritime, aviation, and government users. Services are provided through both postpaid and prepaid plans, and include push-to-talk (PTT) and secure, encrypted communications for government customers.

products.name: Satellite Broadband Data Services (Iridium Certus and OpenPort)
products.description: Enterprise-grade broadband and midband data services delivered globally via the Iridium Certus platform and legacy OpenPort service, supporting high-speed IP connectivity, voice, and safety services for maritime, land mobile, aviation, and government markets. Delivered through specialized terminals and integrated with partner solutions.

products.name: Satellite Internet of Things (IoT) Services
products.description: Global two-way IoT data services enabling asset tracking, telematics, remote monitoring, and machine-to-machine (M2M) communications for industrial, transportation, scientific, and consumer applications. Delivered via small, low-power transceivers and integrated into partner and OEM solutions.

products.name: Hosted Payload Services (including Aireon)
products.description: Hosting third-party payloads, such as Aireon's ADS-B receivers, on Iridium satellites to enable global data collection and delivery services (e.g., air traffic surveillance). Revenue is generated from hosting fees and data transport for these payloads, supporting aviation and other industries.

products.name: Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) Services
products.description: Highly secure, satellite-based PNT services that complement and protect GPS and other GNSS-reliant systems, providing resilient time synchronization and location data for critical infrastructure, cybersecurity, and industrial applications. Delivered via dedicated hardware and planned ASIC integration.

products.name: Engineering and Support Services for Government and Network Operators
products.description: Provision of specialized engineering, technology development, maintenance, and operational support services for government customers and network operators, including building and maintaining gateways, ground entry points, and integration for satellite and defense networks.

products.name: Direct-to-Device (D2D) and NTN Services (Iridium NTN Direct)
products.description: Standards-based narrowband IoT and direct-to-device connectivity services, enabling compatible consumer devices (e.g., smartphones, wearables) to connect directly to the Iridium satellite network for messaging, emergency, and IoT applications. Commercial launch expected in 2026.

products.name: Satellite Communications Equipment (Handsets, Terminals, Transceivers, IoT Devices)
products.description: Manufacture and sale of satellite-enabled handsets, broadband terminals, transceivers, and finished IoT devices for use on the Iridium network, supporting voice, data, PTT, and IoT applications across land, maritime, aviation, and government sectors. Includes ruggedized and secure models for specialized use cases.

products.name: Advanced Battery Systems
products.description: Custom-designed, high-performance battery packs and systems for mission-critical applications in aerospace, defense, aviation, grid storage, subsea, and industrial sectors. These are physically manufactured products requiring advanced engineering, prototyping, testing, certification, and scalable production.

products.name: Battery Management Systems (BMS)
products.description: Modular, cell-agnostic battery management system hardware and software designed to monitor, balance, and ensure the safety and performance of battery systems, particularly for defense and industrial applications. Delivered as integrated electronics and software.

products.name: Vibration Mitigation Solutions (KULR VIBE)
products.description: Proprietary vibration-reduction technology and software for rotary and spinning components in aerospace, automotive, industrial, and renewable energy applications. Delivered as both software and integrated hardware solutions.

products.name: Thermal Management and Safety Solutions
products.description: Thermal runaway protection and heat management products, including SafeCASE and Thermal Runaway Shield (TRS), for safe storage, transport, and operation of lithium batteries in commercial, aerospace, and defense sectors. These are manufactured physical products integrated into battery systems or used standalone.

products.name: Battery Recycling and Lifecycle Management Services
products.description: Services and solutions for safe, compliant storage, transport, and recycling of lithium batteries, leveraging proprietary containment and thermal management technologies. Delivered as a combination of physical products and managed services.

products.name: Custom Battery System Engineering and Design Services
products.description: End-to-end engineering, development, and production services for custom or mission-specific battery architectures, including concept design, modeling, analysis, rapid prototyping, and recurring production. Delivered as a service engagement with physical deliverables.

products.name: Low-Vibration Cooling Fans (Xero Vibe Fan)
products.description: Specialized, low-vibration cooling fans for server and data center applications, designed to increase cooling efficiency and reduce power consumption. These are manufactured hardware products incorporating proprietary balancing technology.

products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: Provision of hash power to mining pools via leased digital asset mining equipment, generating revenue through transaction verification services and digital asset rewards. Delivered as a service using leased hardware infrastructure.

products.name: Wireless Communication Chipsets (4G/4.5G/4.75G/5G)
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells integrated semiconductor chipsets (including baseband modems, RF transceivers, and SoCs) enabling high-speed wireless communication for devices such as fixed wireless access (FWA) CPE, mobile routers (MiFi), industrial IoT modules, and other broadband data devices. These products are physically manufactured using advanced semiconductor processes and delivered to OEMs/ODMs for integration into end-user devices.

products.name: Cellular IoT Chipsets
products.description: Develops and sells specialized chipsets for cellular Internet of Things (IoT) applications, supporting low-speed mobile networks (e.g., eMTC, NB-IoT, Sigfox) for integration into industrial and consumer IoT devices. These are manufactured semiconductor products delivered to device makers for embedded connectivity.

products.name: Reference Designs and Integration Support
products.description: Provides customers (OEMs/ODMs) with reference designs, integration support, and comprehensive software (including source code) to enable efficient incorporation of GCT chipsets into wireless devices. This is a bundled service accompanying chipset sales, involving digital assets and engineering support rather than standalone physical products.

products.name: Electric Utility Services
products.description: Generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity to retail customers in Colorado, Montana, South Dakota, and Wyoming, using a mix of company-owned power plants (coal, natural gas, wind, diesel) and purchased power, delivered via regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas Utility Services
products.description: Transportation and distribution of natural gas to retail customers in Arkansas, Colorado, Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, and Wyoming, using company-owned pipelines, storage, and distribution networks, delivered via regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Wholesale Power Sales
products.description: Sale of excess electric power to other utilities and marketing companies, including affiliates, primarily from company-owned generation assets and power purchase agreements, delivered via the transmission grid.

products.name: Coal Production and Sales
products.description: Surface mining, processing, and sale of low-sulfur sub-bituminous coal from a company-owned mine, primarily to on-site company power plants under long-term contracts, with limited sales to nearby external customers.

products.name: Contractual Pipeline Capacity and Gas Commodity Sales
products.description: Sale of contractual pipeline capacity and natural gas commodities to other utilities and marketing companies, including affiliates, on an as-available basis, leveraging company-owned and contracted pipeline and storage assets.

products.name: Non-Regulated Customer Services (Service Guard Comfort Plan, Tech Services, HomeServe)
products.description: Provision of non-regulated services such as appliance repair, maintenance plans, and technical services to utility customers, delivered through service contracts and in-person labor.

products.name: Choice Gas Program
products.description: Provision of natural gas supply to retail distribution customers in Nebraska and Wyoming under the Choice Gas Program, allowing customers to select their gas supplier, delivered via the company's distribution network.

products.name: Helium Plasma Surgical Systems (Renuvion and J-Plasma)
products.description: Electrosurgical systems using proprietary helium plasma technology, consisting of a generator, handpiece, and helium gas supply, for cutting, coagulation, and ablation of soft tissue in cosmetic and hospital surgical procedures. Manufactured in-house and sold globally to physicians and surgical centers.

products.name: AYON Body Contouring System
products.description: An FDA-cleared, all-in-one body contouring platform integrating fat removal, tissue contraction, ultrasound-assisted liposuction, and electrosurgical capabilities, delivered via a multifunctional console and accessories for comprehensive surgical aesthetic procedures. Manufactured and sold to cosmetic surgeons and surgical centers.

products.name: Single-Use Surgical Handpieces and Accessories
products.description: Disposable handpieces and accessories designed for use with the company's surgical generators, including specialized models for open and minimally invasive procedures, enhancing precision and safety in tissue treatment. Manufactured in-house and sold as consumables to surgical customers.

products.name: Electrosurgical Generators (Apyx One Console and Renuvion System 3)
products.description: High-frequency electrosurgical generators providing RF energy and helium plasma for use in surgical procedures, featuring advanced controls, connectivity, and compatibility with various handpieces. Manufactured and sold to surgical practices and hospitals.

products.name: OEM Electrosurgical Equipment and Medical Devices
products.description: Design, development, and contract manufacturing of electrosurgical generators, medical devices, and related accessories for third-party medical device manufacturers under OEM agreements. Products are manufactured to client specifications and sold directly to other companies for distribution under their brands.

products.name: Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessels (ATEVs) for Vascular Trauma (Symvess)
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular human tissue vessels manufactured at commercial scale using proprietary cell culture and decellularization processes, designed for off-the-shelf implantation as vascular conduits in adults with extremity arterial injury when urgent revascularization is needed and autologous vein graft is not feasible. Delivered as a physical, refrigerated product to hospitals and trauma centers.

products.name: Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessels (ATEVs) for AV Access in Hemodialysis
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular human tissue vessels produced using scalable bioprocessing, intended for use as arteriovenous (AV) access conduits in patients requiring hemodialysis. Delivered as a physical, off-the-shelf product to surgical centers and hospitals, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessels (ATEVs) for Peripheral Artery Disease (PAD)
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular human tissue vessels manufactured for use as bypass conduits in patients with peripheral artery disease, especially when autologous vein is unavailable. Delivered as a physical implant for surgical revascularization procedures.

products.name: Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessels (ATEVs) for Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG)
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular human tissue vessels produced using proprietary technology, intended for use as coronary artery bypass grafts in cardiac surgery. Currently in preclinical development, these are manufactured to small diameters suitable for coronary applications.

products.name: Acellular Tissue Engineered Vessels (ATEVs) for Pediatric Heart Surgery
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular human tissue vessels manufactured in small diameters for use as shunts (e.g., Blalock-Taussig shunt) in pediatric heart surgery, particularly for congenital heart defects. Currently in preclinical development.

products.name: BioVascular Pancreas (BVP) for Type 1 Diabetes
products.description: Acellular tissue engineered vessels modified to deliver pancreatic islet cells for the treatment of Type 1 diabetes. Manufactured using the same platform as ATEVs, with islet cells embedded on the vessel surface, intended to restore insulin production. Currently in preclinical development.

products.name: Engineered Trachea for Airway Repair
products.description: Bioengineered tracheal conduits produced by embedding a medical-grade stent within the wall of an acellular tissue engineered vessel, seeded with smooth muscle cells and decellularized. Intended for surgical repair or reconstruction of the trachea in patients with severe airway injuries. Currently in preclinical development.

products.name: Engineered Urinary Conduits and Esophagus
products.description: Bioengineered, acellular tissue conduits manufactured using the proprietary platform, intended for future use in urinary conduit and esophageal reconstruction. Currently in early-stage or preclinical development.

products.name: Engineered Whole Lung Organs
products.description: Bioengineered, decellularized and recellularized whole lung organs developed using proprietary tissue engineering and bioreactor technology, intended for transplantation in end-stage lung disease. Currently in preclinical research.

products.name: Hyaluronic Acid (HA) Injections for Knee Osteoarthritis
products.description: A portfolio of FDA-approved, injectable hyaluronic acid products (Durolane, GELSYN-3, SUPARTZ FX) for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis, manufactured via bacterial fermentation or animal-derived sources and delivered by physicians in clinical settings.

products.name: Peripheral Nerve Stimulation (PNS) Devices
products.description: A suite of implantable and minimally invasive medical devices (StimRouter, TalisMann, StimTrial) designed to deliver electrical stimulation to peripheral nerves for acute, temporary, and chronic pain management, requiring surgical implantation and programming by physicians.

products.name: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) Systems
products.description: Benchtop medical devices (XCELL PRP System) that process whole blood to produce high-yield PRP for orthopedic and sports medicine applications, distributed to physicians for in-office use.

products.name: Ultrasonic Surgical Systems
products.description: Integrated platforms and handpieces (neXus, BoneScalpel, BoneScalpel Access, SonaStar, SonaStar Elite, SonicOne) for precision bone cutting, soft tissue ablation, and wound debridement in orthopedic, neurosurgery, general surgery, and wound care, requiring physical manufacturing and hospital-based delivery.

products.name: Bone Graft Substitutes
products.description: A range of allograft-derived, synthetic, and demineralized bone graft products (OSTEOAMP, SIGNAFUSE, PUREBONE, Reficio DBM) used to facilitate bone fusion and fill bone voids in orthopedic, spine, and reconstructive surgeries, manufactured from human tissue or synthetic biomaterials and distributed to surgical centers.

products.name: Ultrasound Bone Healing System
products.description: A non-invasive, portable ultrasound device (EXOGEN) for the stimulation and accelerated healing of nonunion and fresh bone fractures, used by patients at home or in clinical settings, requiring digital manufacturing and regulatory approval.

products.name: Tokenized Deposit Platform
products.description: A blockchain-based platform enabling tokenized representations of U.S. dollar-denominated bank deposit accounts, integrated with digital identity, compliance, and payments infrastructure. Delivered via partnerships with regulated banks and fintechs, it supports APIs, white-label solutions, and user-facing digital wallets for retail, institutional, and partner distribution.

products.name: White-Label and API Integration Services for Tokenized Banking
products.description: APIs and white-label solutions that allow fintechs, distribution partners, and other institutions to integrate tokenized deposit functionality into their own platforms, enabling them to offer tokenized U.S. dollar accounts and related services to their customers. Delivered as a technology and compliance infrastructure layer for partners.

products.name: Bitcoin Treasury Management and Yield Generation
products.description: Management of corporate Bitcoin holdings as a treasury reserve asset, including yield generation through options trading and derivatives, executed via external asset managers. This is not a service for external customers but is a core financial activity supporting the business.

products.name: Professional Turf Maintenance Equipment and Irrigation Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells equipment and irrigation systems for professional turf maintenance, including mowers, sprayers, utility vehicles, aerators, and telematics/fleet management software. Delivered through physical manufacturing and supported by digital solutions.

products.name: Landscape and Lighting Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and sells equipment for landscape contractors, including mowers, tractors, turf renovation, and tree care equipment, as well as commercial and residential landscape lighting products. Delivered via physical manufacturing and distributed through dealers and distributors.

products.name: Underground Construction Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells equipment for underground construction, including horizontal directional drills, trenchers, vacuum excavators, utility locators, inspection systems, and pipe rehabilitation tools. Products are physically manufactured and sold to specialty contractors and rental companies.

products.name: Rental and Specialty Construction Equipment
products.description: Manufactures and sells equipment for the rental and specialty construction markets, including skid steers, trenchers, stump grinders, material handlers, and concrete construction equipment. Products are physically manufactured and distributed to rental companies and dealers.

products.name: Snow and Ice Management Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells snowplows, salt and brine ice control products, and related accessories for snow and ice management, including for trucks, ATVs, and utility vehicles. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through dealers and distributors.

products.name: Agricultural Irrigation Systems
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells drip irrigation and related products for agricultural and greenhouse applications, including drip tape, tubing, emitters, filters, and design software. Products are physically manufactured and sold through dealers and distributors.

products.name: Residential Lawn and Garden Equipment
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells walk power mowers, zero-turn riding mowers, and yard tools such as trimmers, blowers, chainsaws, and edgers for homeowners. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retailers, dealers, and online channels.

products.name: Residential Snow Throwers
products.description: Manufactures and sells battery, electric, and gas-powered snow throwers and power shovels for homeowners, designed for clearing snow from various surfaces. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Residential Irrigation and Lighting Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells irrigation and lighting products for residential landscapes, including sprinkler systems, controllers, sensors, and lighting fixtures. Products are physically manufactured and distributed through dealers and retailers.

products.name: Medical Aesthetic Systems
products.description: A suite of minimally invasive and non-invasive energy-based devices for aesthetic procedures such as skin tightening, wrinkle reduction, body contouring, cellulite reduction, fat reduction, hair removal, acne treatment, and vascular/pigmented lesion treatment. These systems are manufactured using proprietary (MP)2, RF, IPL, laser, EMS, and micro-coring technologies and are delivered as physical devices to clinics and practitioners.

products.name: Hair Restoration Systems
products.description: Robotic and automated systems (ARTAS, ARTAS iX, NeoGraft) for surgical hair transplantation using FUE techniques, including robotic follicle harvesting, site making, and implantation. These are physical devices sold to hair restoration surgeons and clinics, requiring manufacturing, regulatory clearance, and in-person clinical use.

products.name: Consumables and Disposables
products.description: Single-use or limited-use items such as applicators, handpieces, and treatment kits required for the operation of Venus Concept's aesthetic and hair restoration systems. These are manufactured physical products sold alongside or after the initial system purchase.

products.name: Extended Warranty and Service Contracts
products.description: Post-sale service offerings including extended warranty contracts, technical support, and maintenance for Venus Concept's installed systems. These services are delivered through in-person or remote support and require technical staff and infrastructure.

products.name: Marketing Supplies and Kits
products.description: Marketing materials, launch kits, and promotional supplies provided to customers to support the introduction and promotion of Venus Concept products and treatments. These are physical or digital products delivered to clinics and practitioners.

products.name: Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs)
products.description: Programmable semiconductor devices manufactured using advanced silicon processes, delivered as hardware chips for integration into customer systems across communications, computing, industrial, automotive, and consumer markets. Includes both small and mid-range FPGAs, with specialized variants for control, video connectivity, general purpose, and security applications.

products.name: FPGA Design Software and Development Tools
products.description: Proprietary software platforms and tools that enable customers to design, configure, and program Lattice FPGAs, including design convergence, embedded processor design, and system-level solution stacks. Delivered digitally to support hardware integration and accelerate customer time-to-market.

products.name: Intellectual Property (IP) Licensing
products.description: Licensing of proprietary technology, including standard IP (such as HDMI and MHL), FPGA IP cores, and patents, to external customers for integration into their own products or for royalty generation. Revenue is generated through upfront fees and ongoing royalties.

products.name: Design and IP Services
products.description: Professional services including design services and custom IP development for customers seeking tailored solutions based on Lattice’s technology and expertise. Delivered through project-based engagements to enable customer-specific hardware or software implementations.

products.name: Video Connectivity ASSPs (Application Specific Standard Products)
products.description: Standard, non-programmable semiconductor products focused on video connectivity applications, sold as legacy products with minimal ongoing development or support. Delivered as hardware chips for integration into customer systems.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Origination of commercial real estate loans, commercial and industrial loans, and commercial real estate construction loans to businesses, professionals, and real estate developers, primarily secured by business assets or real estate. Delivered through in-person relationship banking and underwriting, requiring financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Residential Lending
